name: whisperdesk-enclave-loop
description: Node runner for the client half of WhisperDesk's enclave loop: takes the `wd-client loop` JSON, funds taker deposit + maker bond, calls DvPEscrow.lock() with the enclave-signed MatchInstruction (no local signing), pays the XRPL leg, requests an FDC proof, and calls release(). Reuses scripts/e2e/lib/* and scripts/e2e/config.mjs directly (relative imports, not a package dependency) — this package.json only needs its OWN direct imports (ethers) resolvable; scripts/e2e's own node_modules resolves its internal imports (dotenv, xrpl) independently since Node resolves each module's bare specifiers relative to that module's own directory.
